description: Creates a contact (CRM record) in Bird — additive, sends no message. Contacts are unique by email. Bird API: POST /v1/contacts.

data.description: Custom property values. Each key must be a property created via the contact-properties API; values match the property's declared type.

email.description: The contact's email address (unique within the workspace).

external_id.description: Your own identifier for this contact (unique within the workspace).

name: bird_create_contact
title: Create a contact
